en: The rest of your team gained\nEXP. Points!\p
zh: 其他宝可梦也获得了\n经验值！\p

en: But, {B_BUFF1} can't learn\nmore than four moves.\p
zh: 但是，{B_BUFF1}无法学会\n四个以上的招式。\p

en: Delete a move to make\nroom for {B_BUFF2}?
zh: 要忘记一个招式，\n来学习{B_BUFF2}吗？
要派出下一只宝可梦吗？
{B_PLAYER_NAME}已经没有\n能战斗的宝可梦了！\p

en: {B_EFF_NAME_WITH_PREFIX} is paralyzed!\nIt may be unable to move!

zh: {B_SCR_ACTIVE_NAME_WITH_PREFIX}的{B_SCR_ACTIVE_ABILITY}\n让{B_EFF_NAME_WITH_PREFIX}麻痹了！\l可能会无法行动！
{B_ATK_PREFIX2}的队伍\n被神秘的帷幕包围了！
{B_DEF_NAME_WITH_PREFIX}的队伍\n受到了神秘守护的保护！

en: {B_ATK_PREFIX3}'s party is no longer\nprotected by SAFEGUARD!
zh: {B_ATK_PREFIX3}的队伍\n不再受神秘守护保护了！
但是{B_DEF_NAME_WITH_PREFIX}\n在吵闹声中无法入睡！
但是吵闹声让\n{B_DEF_NAME_WITH_PREFIX}保持清醒！

en: {B_ATK_NAME_WITH_PREFIX} is trying\nto take its foe with it!
{B_ATK_NAME_WITH_PREFIX} cut its own HP and\nlaid a CURSE on {B_DEF_NAME_WITH_PREFIX}!
SPIKES were scattered all around\nthe opponent's side!
zh: 对手的周围\n散落着撒菱！

en: {B_ATK_NAME_WITH_PREFIX} cut its own HP\nand maximized ATTACK!
zh: {B_ATK_NAME_WITH_PREFIX}削减了HP，\n把攻击提升到了最大！

en: {B_ATK_NAME_WITH_PREFIX} wants the\nopponent to bear a GRUDGE!
{B_ATK_NAME_WITH_PREFIX}'s {B_BUFF1} lost\nall its PP due to the GRUDGE!
{B_ATK_NAME_WITH_PREFIX} waits for a target\nto make a move!
A soothing aroma wafted\nthrough the area!
zh: 舒心的香气\n扩散开来了！

en: {B_ACTIVE_NAME_WITH_PREFIX} can't use the same\nmove in a row due to the TORMENT!\p
zh: 因为无理取闹，{B_ACTIVE_NAME_WITH_PREFIX}\n不能连续使用同一招式！\p
现在不能忘记\n秘传招式。\p

en: Player battled to a draw against\n{B_LINK_OPPONENT1_NAME}!
Player battled to a draw against\n{B_LINK_OPPONENT1_NAME} and {B_LINK_OPPONENT2_NAME}!
No! There's no running\nfrom a TRAINER battle!\p
zh: 不行！不能从\n和训练家的对战中逃走！\p

en: PROF. BIRCH: Don't leave me like this!\p
zh: 小田卷博士：别丢下我不管啊！\p
它在混乱中\n攻击了自己！

en: But it failed to SPIT UP\na thing!
zh: 但是什么也\n没能喷出来！

en: But it failed to SWALLOW\na thing!
zh: 但是什么也\n没能吞下去！

en: The wind turned into a\nHEAT WAVE!

zh: 所有的能力变化\n都消失了！

en: It was too weak to make\na SUBSTITUTE!
zh: 体力太弱，\n无法制造替身！

en: All affected POKéMON will\nfaint in three turns!
zh: 听到歌声的宝可梦\n将在3回合后倒下！

en: There's no PP left for\nthis move!\p
zh: 这个招式的PP\n已经没有了！\p

en: But there was no PP left\nfor the move!
zh: 但是这个招式的PP\n已经没有了！

en: {PLAY_SE SE_DING_DONG}ANNOUNCER: You're out of\nSAFARI BALLS! Game over!\p
zh: {PLAY_SE SE_DING_DONG}广播：你的狩猎球\n已经用完了！游戏结束！\p
对手已经很虚弱了！\n上吧，{B_BUFF1}！
训练家把精灵球挡开了！

en: It dodged the thrown BALL!\nThis POKéMON can't be caught!
zh: 它躲开了扔出的精灵球！\n这只宝可梦无法捕捉！
糟糕！\n宝可梦从球里出来了！
啊！\n明明好像已经抓到了！
{B_OPPONENT_MON1_NAME}的数据\n已登录到宝可梦图鉴。\p

en: The BOX is full!\nYou can't catch any more!\p
zh: 盒子已经满了！\n无法再捕捉宝可梦了！\p

en: You throw a BALL now, right?\nI… I'll do my best!
zh: 现在要扔精灵球了，对吧？\n我……我会努力的！

en: {PALETTE 5}{COLOR_HIGHLIGHT_SHADOW DYNAMIC_COLOR4 DYNAMIC_COLOR5 DYNAMIC_COLOR6}Which move should\nbe forgotten?
zh: {PALETTE 5}{COLOR_HIGHLIGHT_SHADOW DYNAMIC_COLOR4 DYNAMIC_COLOR5 DYNAMIC_COLOR6}要忘记\n哪个招式？

en: Will the championship dream come true?!\p
REFEREE: If nothing is decided in\n3 turns, we will go to judging!
zh: 裁判：如果3回合内\n分不出胜负，就进行判定！

en: REFEREE: That's it! We will now go to\njudging to determine the winner!
zh: 裁判：到此为止！\n现在进行判定决出胜者！

en: REFEREE: Judging category 1, Mind!\nThe POKéMON showing the most guts!\p
zh: 裁判：判定项目1，精神！\n最有斗志的宝可梦！\p

en: REFEREE: Judging category 2, Skill!\nThe POKéMON using moves the best!\p
zh: 裁判：判定项目2，技巧！\n最会使用招式的宝可梦！\p

en: REFEREE: Judging category 3, Body!\nThe POKéMON with the most vitality!\p
zh: 裁判：判定项目3，身体！\n最有活力的宝可梦！\p

en: REFEREE: Judgment: 3 to 3!\nWe have a draw!\p
{B_PLAYER_MON1_NAME} defeated the opponent\n{B_OPPONENT_MON1_NAME} in a REFEREE's decision!
zh: {B_PLAYER_MON1_NAME}通过裁判判定\n打败了对手的{B_OPPONENT_MON1_NAME}！

en: {B_PLAYER_MON1_NAME} lost to the opponent\n{B_OPPONENT_MON1_NAME} in a REFEREE's decision!
zh: {B_PLAYER_MON1_NAME}通过裁判判定\n输给了对手的{B_OPPONENT_MON1_NAME}！

en: {B_PLAYER_MON1_NAME} tied the opponent\n{B_OPPONENT_MON1_NAME} in a REFEREE's decision!
zh: {B_PLAYER_MON1_NAME}通过裁判判定\n和对手的{B_OPPONENT_MON1_NAME}打成平手！

en: Would you like to forfeit the match\nand quit now?
Player battled to a draw against\n{B_TRAINER1_CLASS} {B_TRAINER1_NAME}!
Would you like to record your battle\non your FRONTIER PASS?
zh: 要把对战记录\n保存到开拓通行证吗？

en: {B_PLAYER_NAME}'s battle result was recorded\non the FRONTIER PASS.
zh: {B_PLAYER_NAME}的对战结果\n已记录在开拓通行证上。

en: The save file has been updated.
The save file is corrupted. The\nprevious save file will be loaded.
zh: 存档已损坏。\n将读取上一次的存档。

en: The save file has been erased\ndue to corruption or damage.
zh: 存档因损坏而\n被删除了。
没有找到符合条件的宝可梦。
没有存放道具的\n空间了。

en: {PLAYER} used the\n{STR_VAR_2}.\pWild POKéMON will be lured.{PAUSE_UNTIL_PRESS}
{PLAYER} used the\n{STR_VAR_2}.\pWild POKéMON will be repelled.{PAUSE_UNTIL_PRESS}
zh: {PLAYER}使用了\n{STR_VAR_2}。\p野生宝可梦不会出现了。{PAUSE_UNTIL_PRESS}

en: {STR_VAR_1}, is it?\nThat'll be ¥{STR_VAR_2}. Do you want it?
You have no more room for this\nitem.{PAUSE_UNTIL_PRESS}
zh: 这个道具已经\n放不下了。{PAUSE_UNTIL_PRESS}

en: I'll throw in a PREMIER BALL, too.{PAUSE_UNTIL_PRESS}

zh: 这里没有可以居合斩的东西。
从宝可梦那里\n拿走了邮件。{PAUSE_UNTIL_PRESS}

en: The {STR_VAR_2} was taken and\nreplaced with the {STR_VAR_1}.{PAUSE_UNTIL_PRESS}

zh: 这是你唯一一只\n能战斗的宝可梦。

en: Take out items from the PC.
Throw away items stored in the PC.
zh: 丢掉存放在电脑里的道具。

en: There is no more\nroom in the BAG.

zh: 正在记录……\n请不要关闭电源。
